author: Antonialock
body:
I see that rpp201 and rpp203 are annotated to RNA pol I complex + transcription elongation by RNA polymerase I from PMID:33536435 . However when I look at the 3 structures these two proteins (and ssb2) are not present (the rest are there). Should they be annotated to this complex and process?

I got there from this signature:
FunFam signature
[1.10.10.1410:FF:000002](https://www.cathdb.info/version/latest/funfam/1.10.10.1410:FF:000002)
taxon
[Taphrinomycotina](https://www.uniprot.org/taxonomy/451866)
and the search: https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3A%22funfam-1.10.10.1410%3AFF%3A000002%22%29+AND+%28taxonomy_id%3A451866%29

author: ValWood
body: Gah, I made these. I have no idea why they are there, though... they aren't mentioned in the paper as far as I can see, and they definitely aren't RNA pol I components. The members are clearly defined.

author: ValWood
body:
Hmm they all have the synonym rpa2, so that is why they are there. I'm not sure how I ended up with them in the session though, that shouldn't be possible....
The annotations are now deleted...

How does it get picked up by ARBA though? Presumably PomBase is the only annotation source of this error?

author: Antonialock
body:
Yes, currently ARBA needs 5 SP proteins to make rules from interpro domains, but only two to make rules based on funfam.

That annotation was only made for Taphrinomycotina from those two pombe proteins (cerevisiae would "negate" generalizing this annotation further)

author: Antonialock
body: So I think this can close since it will be fixed once it trickles through.
